shorts.hook: Lean your whole weight on Him
shorts.title: You Can Rest Even Before Problems Solve

rubric.reasons: Strong opening metaphor of leaning whole weight on God; perfectly loops from ending 'You will not be moved'.
rubric.hook_line: Lean your whole weight on Him
rubric.title: You Can Rest Even Before Problems Solve

shorts.text: You can lean your whole weight on him, and he will not move. I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope. Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore. My flesh also shall rest in hope. Your body can rest tonight, not because every problem is solved, but because your hope is in God. He is at your right hand. You will not be moved.

shorts.hook: Lay your head down clean tonight
shorts.title: Lay Your Head Down Free from Guilt

rubric.reasons: Deeply compassionate release of bedtime guilt and regret, resolving with assurance of God's faithful pardon.
rubric.hook_line: Lay your head down clean tonight
rubric.title: Lay Your Head Down Free from Guilt

shorts.text: Father, I also bring you what I regret. The impatient word. The thing I should have done and did not. The moment I chose myself over someone else. I do not want to carry guilt into my sleep. I confess it to you honestly, and I receive your forgiveness. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Faithful and just. God does not forgive you reluctantly. He forgives you because he promised he would, and he always keeps his promises. So tonight you can lay your head down clean.

shorts.hook: Place your tomorrow in God's hands
shorts.title: A Nighttime Blessing for Peaceful Sleep

rubric.reasons: Clean, standalone evening prayer and blessing with a clear, comforting start and ending.
rubric.hook_line: Place your tomorrow in God's hands
rubric.title: A Nighttime Blessing for Peaceful Sleep

shorts.text: Lord, as sleep comes, I place myself completely in your hands. My body, my mind, my heart, my family, my tomorrow. Watch over me through the night, and wake me to your mercy in the morning. And now receive this blessing as you sleep. Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all. Sleep well, in the shelter of his love. In Jesus' name, amen.
